title: The Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: SHN -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy early‑morning set captured on a solid soundboard, with blazing China Cat > Rider and an unforgettable Shakedown.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard recording is generally clear and balanced, though the mix settles after the opening minutes. The show is a short but intense early‑morning burst of nonstop jams—China Cat into The Rider, a monster Shakedown, and a spacey Space > Not Fade Away sequence are repeatedly highlighted. Overall the performance radiates high energy with only a few perfunctory moments in the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (8 of 9) give 4‑5 stars and praise both the musical intensity and the soundboard quality; only one anomalous 0‑star rating does not outweigh the consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice soundboard overall, though the opening mix is a bit off before settling; later sections are crisp. One reviewer notes that the file has been patched and pitch‑corrected to improve balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A rapid, high‑tempo first set that never slows down, followed by a second set with more conventional numbers and a brief space/Not Fade Away peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His power chords are noted as driving the early‑morning intensity.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob’s slide work and tone are praised, especially on Minglewood and Samson.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard approach is highlighted for adapting to the uptempo vibe; later reviewers mention fixing distorted keys in the source file.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers receive strong praise for dynamic, high‑energy playing throughout the set.
